judgeWarnings: feasibility: If built, the spec must pin a coarse stylised land set (about a dozen polygons written from memory, since no data may be downloaded), keep OffscreenCanvas optional, unit-test the J2 and ISS figures, and cut polar view and Molniya first.

safety: Minor framing: hand-drawn coastlines and city dots with no national borders (avoids disputed-territory politics), NASA, USGS and ESA as plain-text citations without logos or imagery, Molniya figures shown 'as of 2026-10-11, per arXiv 2007.04341', and a note that tracks drift from real satellites.
